meta.title: Mark — Personal Site Publisher Mode
meta.description: Try Daymark in a throwaway WordPress. Lands in the /daymark app shell, logged in as admin.
meta.author: jeffpaul

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$plugin = Daymark_Plugin::instance();

$preset_sites = [
	'https://jeffpaul.com'    => 'Jeffrey Paul',
	'https://jondesrosiers.com' => '',
	'https://aaron.jorb.in'  => 'Aaron Jorbin',
	'https://xkcd.com'        => 'xkcd',
];

foreach ( $preset_sites as $site_url => $site_name ) {
	$result = $plugin->subscriptions->subscribe_to_site( $site_url );
	if ( ! is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
		if ( '' !== $site_name ) {
			$plugin->subscriptions->update( (int) $result, [ 'site_title' => $site_name ] );
		}
		$plugin->subscription_poller->poll_subscription( (int) $result );
	}
}

// Sample Marks for each Mark type and Featured Content kind, from the
// plugin's own checkout (sample photos live next to the script).
$seed = dirname( DAYMARK_PLUGIN_FILE ) . '/.github/blueprints/seed-sample-content.php';
if ( file_exists( $seed ) ) {
	require $seed;
}
